exposure: baseline Impact of Events Scale Revised score
Time (first study phase vs. second study phase)
finding: Emergency caesarean section and neuroticism were predictors of increased postpartum PTSD symptoms at the first study phase, while living in a nuclear family and in a city were predictors of decreased PTSD symptoms at the second study phase.
mod_finding: Emergency caesarean section was associated with an increased likelihood of postpartum PTSD symptoms at the first study phase (OR 2.48, 95% CI 1.13-5.43).
